subject: Ciências Humanas e Sociais Aplicadas
description_pt: Debater e avaliar o papel da indústria cultural e das culturas de massa no estímulo ao consumismo, seus impactos econômicos e socioambientais, com vistas à percepção crítica das necessidades criadas pelo consumo e à adoção de hábitos sustentáveis.

components.description_pt: Analisar o papel da indústria cultural em estimular consumismo e moldar necessidades de consumo
components.description_en: Analyze the role of the culture industry in stimulating consumerism and shaping consumer needs

components.description_pt: Avaliar os impactos econômicos e socioambientais do consumo em massa impulsionado pela mídia e cultura popular
components.description_en: Evaluate the economic and socio-environmental impacts of mass consumption driven by media and popular culture
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Desenvolver consciência crítica sobre necessidades de consumo artificialmente criadas pela cultura de massa
components.description_en: Develop critical awareness of artificially created consumer needs promoted by mass culture

components.description_pt: Identificar hábitos sustentáveis que contrabalancem os efeitos das pressões culturais orientadas ao consumo
components.description_en: Identify sustainable habits that counteract the effects of consumption-driven cultural pressures
components.cc_component_description: Compare the environmental effects of human activities with efforts to mitigate those effects

cc_matches.description: Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.

Human activities in agriculture, industry, and everyday life have had major effects on the land, vegetation, streams, ocean, air, and even outer space. But individuals and communities are doing things to help protect Earth’s resources and environments.
